hero.title: Every Night, Just Me
hero.subtitle: A postpartum night-coordination system that replaces nightly arguing with a pre-agreed roster, a fairness ledger, and the exact words to make it stick.
hero.one_line_promise: A written, fair night-shift system both adults follow - so she gets a protected sleep opportunity, and nobody has to ask.

short_description: A written, fair night-shift system both adults follow - so she gets a protected sleep opportunity, and nobody has to ask.
trust_line: Educational content - not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice. This coordinates night-care between adults; it never diagnoses or treats any condition and never replaces professional care.
evidence_label: Educational content informed by relationship research, postpartum guidance, and lived experience. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.

situation_block.label: Your situation
situation_block.body: You are running every night alone - feeding, settling, soothing - while your partner sleeps, works away, or thinks 'helping' means one nappy change. There is no agreed system, so every night is renegotiated by exhaustion and resentment. You cannot get a single protected 4-5 hour block, and 'can you help more?' keeps producing one-off gestures instead of a system.
